title: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning: The Alignment Redundancy Bound and Decomposed JEPAs
abstract: arXiv:2611.16639v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cross-modal alignment is the default objective for multimodal representation learning, but it rests on an implicit assumption: that the two modalities are roughly symmetric views of the same underlying state. We show that this assumption fails on real multimodal data, and that alignment as a sole objective is provably lossy under informational asymmetry. We formalize the failure through Partial Information Decomposition, proving that cross-modal alignment retains at most the redundant information atom and annihilates the modality-unique and synergistic structure on which asymmetric tasks depend. We give the exact PID decomposition of the alignment information bottleneck, characterize its failure regime, and derive a sufficiency condition that any encoder objective must satisfy to preserve all four informational atoms. We then introduce Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA), which realizes this condition by factorizing each modality's latent space

translated_title: 非对称多模态学习：对齐冗余界与分解式JEPA
translated_abstract: 跨模态对齐是多模态表征学习的默认目标，但它建立在一个隐含假设之上：即两种模态大致是同一底层状态的对称视图。我们证明这一假设在真实多模态数据上并不成立，并且在信息不对称条件下，仅以对齐为目标在可证明意义上是有损的。我们通过部分信息分解（Partial Information Decomposition, PID）将这一失效形式化，证明跨模态对齐至多只能保留冗余信息原子，并摧毁非对称任务所依赖的模态独有信息和协同信息结构。我们给出了对齐信息瓶颈的精确PID分解，刻画了其失效区域，并推导出任何编码器目标若要保留全部四个信息原子所必须满足的充分条件。随后我们提出分解式JEPA（D-JEPA），通过分解每个模态的潜在空间来实现这一条件。
tldr: 论文证明跨模态对齐在信息不对称下至多保留冗余信息原子而破坏模态独有与协同信息结构，并提出分解式JEPA（D-JEPA），通过分解各模态潜在空间来保留全部四类信息原子。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that cross-modal alignment retains at most the redundant information atom under informational asymmetry, and introduces Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA), which factorizes each modality's latent space to preserve all four information atoms.
